scope: Damage admission and the first eighteen damaging-hit statements, through damage-pool feeding. Remaining sustain, threat, world reactions, delivery, death and later status/effect dispatch retain separate boundaries.
observations: Invoke the original complete resolver. The native sim tap observes without mutating packets/results. Record native results, live host calls, stat queries, RNG, actor state, account deeds, pool/mimic state, cues and partial failures. Explicit host-callback courses exercise mutation, nesting and exceptions without replacing applyHit.
hostBoundary: Live active player identity and account progression authority
Spatial cue construction, trigger targeting and fixture contact
Underlying healing, buff consumption, thorns, charges and proc execution
expectedSemantics: Only the captured authored definition or force flag admits damage; delivery effects do not independently admit it.
Player deeds capture life, hidden state and panic before assault packet mutation and damage. Self-damage uses actual life loss with an overkill floor.
Evasion and passive block end the whole hit after their ordered rewards and reactions. A seeping block may kill, but healing and triggers precede the lethal check.
An immune contact still knocks fixtures with the captured tone and a false wounding flag, then stops.
Landed results capture critical state and total at distinct points; received amounts are borrowed into struck/hurt reactions. Zero-damage contacts can differ from refusals.
Positive damage stamps both sides, then critical stamps and hurt reactions, before feeding pools from a snapshot of packet entries.
Mimic capture is a separate live host policy; its landing occurrence follows refusals and precedes dealt capture and rear feedback.
Host callbacks may nest hits, change live state or fail; no rollback or shared scratch frame is implied.
